## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A 4-juan Late-Míng military-formations treatise by Hé Liángchén, in the *wōkòu* defence tradition of Táng Shùnzhī ([KR3b0016](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR3/KR3b/KR3b0016)) and Qī Jìguāng ([KR3b0019](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR3/KR3b/KR3b0019)). Composition: bracketed by the *wōkòu* crisis period (1550s–1590s). The frontmatter brackets to ca. 1560–1600.

**Abstract**

The *Zhèn jì* is one of the principal Late-Míng military-tactical treatises. The bibliographic record: SKQS *Zǐbù — Bīngjiā lèi*.
